text:
elaine: Quick thread to finalize the observability canary guardrails for dashboards + tracing + cost analytics. Need clear launch scope and what we can push to v2.

ryan: TL;DR proposal: launch with lightweight dashboard widgets + sampled traces + route/model cost summary. Blockers: sampling defaults, who sees raw traces, and CSV export performance.

marta: From infra: sampling needs to be org-configurable and default low (0.5%-1%). Also we should stream spans to the tracing collector asynchronously to avoid blocking generation path.

gabe: Product acceptance idea: 1) Widgets: cost-by-route (24h/7d), error-rate sparkline, top-5 latency hotspots. 2) Tracing: emit trace_id/span_id for all requests, sampled linkable traces at 1% org default. 3) Cost: per-model token totals + estimated $ per window.

nina: Security ask: only users with "obs:read_traces" role can click-through to raw traces. Add audit log entry when traces are accessed.

elaine: Agreed on RBAC. Also add a privacy bucket for PII redaction in traces (v1 basic scrub, v2 advanced).

ryan: Launch gating thresholds:
- latency: no more than 5% increase in p95 across canary orgs vs baseline
- errors: no more than +0.5% absolute increase in overall error rate
- stability: no new CPU/GPU OOMs during 2-week canary

marta: We'll add real-time alerts for p95 and ingestion lag. Ops playbook: automated rollback if p95 > threshold for 15m or ingestion lag > 30s.

gabe: UX acceptance: CSV export for each tile, but paginate with cursor (max 10k rows) — otherwise defer full export. Also enable CSV of top-traced-flows with trace_ids.

nina: Compliance: retention defaults 30d for raw traces, 90d for aggregated metrics. Customers can request different retention in Private/Dedicated.

ops-bot: canary deployment started: obs/console-v1 -> 5% cohorts. Link: https://deploys.redwood/obs/1768129999

elaine: OK final carve: MUST ship in v1: three widgets (cost-by-route, error-sparkline, latency-hotspots), trace_id/span_id on requests, 1% sampling default (org-configurable), RBAC gating for trace access, CSV export (paginated).

ryan: v2 backlog: request replay, deep error grouping by stack/signature, dynamic sampling by traffic pattern, PII scrub tuning.

marta: I'll produce the smoke test matrix (latency, error delta, RBAC checks, export size). Gabe please add the UI props and API contract so frontend can wire tiles.

gabe: On it. I'll post contract PR and lightweight mock images.

elaine: Thanks. Next check-in Wed 9am to review first canary metrics. If any canary fails, we pause rollout and call oncall.

ops-bot: alert rule created: obs-canary-p95-rollback (p95 > baseline *1.05 for 15m)
